title: Iron Legion fatigue rules (content/rules/fatigue.json5)
description: Engine tunables read by the fatigue system and the combat and movement multipliers it feeds (Simulation Spec 8 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

rate_idle.description: Fatigue change per second while idle; negative recovers (SIM-FAT-002).

armour_rate.description: Added to every positive rate per point of unit armour (SIM-FAT-002).

thresholds.description: Upper bounds of Fresh, Active and Tired; Exhausted above the last (SIM-FAT-003).

speed_loss.description: Speed multiplier loss at full fatigue (SIM-FAT-004).

attack_loss.description: Attack multiplier loss at full fatigue (SIM-FAT-004).

defence_loss.description: Defence multiplier loss at full fatigue (SIM-FAT-004).

interval_gain.description: Attack interval multiplier gain at full fatigue (SIM-FAT-004).
